events.title: Russian Putin-critical artist killed in Poland; suspect held
events.detail: A Russian artist whose work criticised Putin was assassinated in Poland in June 2026. Security services later detained a suspected killer reportedly travelling on a Georgian passport. Cited by reporting as part of the wider hybrid-threat context; exact date not confirmed in the sources reviewed.

events.title: Tusk announces foiled Russian-ordered murder plot in Warsaw
events.detail: PM Tusk announced that a 29-year-old Russian citizen, detained 7 August, had been recruited by Russian intelligence to kill a person with joint US and Ukrainian citizenship in Warsaw. Police said he was charged with planning a murder and accepting a murder order (2–15 years); he is in pretrial detention. Minister Tomasz Siemoniak said US services cooperated. This is a separate case from the October threats.

events.title: Two men arrested for threats against Tusk (Przemyśl, Oława)
events.detail: Per Interia, in September a 56-year-old man from Przemyśl who posted a threatening video and a 52-year-old man from Oława, charged with criminal threats, were arrested over threats against Tusk. The report does not link these to the October case.

era: October 2026 threat against Tusk and Kosiniak-Kamysz

events.title: Informant warns State Protection Service of planned attack
events.detail: Services received information overnight 10–11 Oct, via the SOP (Government Protection Bureau), about a planned attack on Tusk and Deputy PM/Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz. Media reports (TVN24, Polsat) say the tipster described contact with a radical group on social media seeking volunteers for a firearms attack; this account is unofficial.

events.title: Police, SOP and ABW convene at counter-terrorism centre
events.detail: A meeting of police, SOP and ABW officers was held at the ABW Counter-Terrorism Centre at the request of Interior Minister Kierwiński and special-services coordinator Siemoniak. Spokesman Jacek Dobrzyński called the matter 'deadly serious' and said the PM is under protection.

events.title: Man who threatened Tusk and defence minister detained
events.detail: Interior Minister Kierwiński announced police had detained the man who threatened and planned an attack on Tusk. MSWiA says he is about 60, a Polish citizen, previously on services' records, and was detained in Lower Silesia; police questioned him and searched his home. No charges, weapons seizure or foreign link had been reported as of publication. Tusk thanked police for 'quick and decisive action'.

events.title: Czech leaders offer support to Poland
events.detail: Czech PM Andrej Babiš said Prague would help if Poland asked; Foreign Minister Petr Macinka called the threat much more serious than earlier similar ones and offered help to Polish FM Radosław Sikorski. No NATO statement had been found.
